test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

The cry of an owl
solution: The correct answer is '**Hoot**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Hoot**'. • It means 'the sound an owl (= type of bird) makes, or a shout showing anger or amusement'. [एक उल्लू (= पक्षी का प्रकार) की आवाज, या क्रोध या मनोरंजन दिखाने वाली चिल्लाहट] • *Example: There were some **hoots** from the audience at these so-called experts.* **Correct Answer:__** *Hoot.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Squawk**: (used especially about a bird) to make a loud unpleasant noise. [(पक्षी का) चींख़ मारने जैसी आवाज़ करना] • **Moo**: the sound that a cow makes. (गाय का रँभाना) • **Coo**: to make a soft low sound like a bird (a dove). (कूकना, कबूतर जैसे गुटरगूं करना) 32:Tb10, The correct answer is **'has been cancelled'.**
